sources.title: Acute Effects of Various Stretching Techniques on Range of Motion: A Systematic Review with Meta-Analysis
sources.notes: Evaluates the acute effects of different stretching techniques and durations on range of motion and physical performance. Emphasizes that long-duration static stretching enhances ROM but can impair performance, whereas dynamic stretching improves readiness with minimal ROM gains.

sources.title: Chronic effects of stretching on range of motion with consideration of potential moderating variables: A systematic review with meta-analysis
sources.journal: Journal of Sport and Health Science
sources.notes: Concludes that PNF or static stretching should be used to maximize long-term ROM, and demonstrates that variables like volume, intensity, and frequency play a lesser role than technique.

sources.title: Effect of stretching training on the viscoelastic properties of human tendon structures in vivo
sources.notes: Foundational biomechanics study demonstrating that chronic stretching training primarily affects the viscosity (decreasing hysteresis) but not the elasticity of human tendon structures.

sources.title: Effects of Self-Myofascial Release on Athletes Physical Performance: A Systematic Review
sources.journal: Journal of Functional Morphology and Kinesiology
sources.notes: Determines that self-myofascial release (SMR) and foam rolling have acute positive effects on flexibility and range of motion without impairing muscle performance during maximal strength and power actions.

sources.title: Normal Range of Motion (ROM) Values — AAOS Chart by Joint
sources.notes: The primary clinical reference standard establishing normal baseline limits for all human joint measurements via goniometry. Crucial for defining the healthy threshold parameters

sources.title: Normal Joint Range of Motion (ROM) and Variations Within Normal Limits in Physiotherapy
sources.notes: Summarizes standard ROM values across major joints while detailing expected variations within standard limits commonly encountered in a physical therapy setting.

sources.title: The Effects of Long-Term Ankle Stretching on Range of Motion
sources.journal: Journal of Sports Science and Medicine
sources.notes: Analyzes the impacts of prolonged ankle dorsiflexion stretching interventions on both joint mobility and underlying structural changes.

sources.title: Current Concepts in Muscle Stretching for Exercise and Rehabilitation
sources.journal: The International Journal of Sports Physical Therapy
sources.notes: Provides a comprehensive overview of stretching techniques, including static, dynamic, and pre-contraction stretching
